name: Bady Bassitt (Brazil)
description: Pale yellow field charged at the centre with a large blue butterfly between two blue stars.
history: Bady Bassitt is a municipality in the state of São Paulo, Brazil. Flags of the World describes the yellow flag with the blue butterfly and stars; a separate flag of the municipal council, prescribed by Decree No. 117 of 19 August 2011, is diagonally divided blue and yellow.

features.role: a star on either side of the butterfly
